Free Health Screening Event
Visit the downtown clinic on June 14 for free health screenings.
Services include blood pressure checks, cholesterol tests, and
diabetes screenings.
Open to all residents from 8:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M.
No appointment necessary.
Early detection can save lives!
